title: Binance Will Add Berachain (BERA) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Berachain (BERA)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin ,  Binance Auto-Invest , and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn BERA Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-02-06 13:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . From  2025-02-07 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase  BERA  using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  BERA  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Revolut  or buy and sell  BERA  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  BERA  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  BERA  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  BERA  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  BERA  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  BERA/USDT  and  BERA/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2025-02-06 16:00 (UTC). Binance VIP 7 to VIP 9 users will be able to borrow the abovementioned asset(s) on Cross and Isolated Margin approximately 30 minutes before it is open for Margin trading.  Notes:  Interest is charged on these loans even though margin trading for these tokens has not commenced. Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M BERA Perpetual Contract  at  2025-02-06 15:00 (UTC) , with up to 75x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M BERA Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract BERAUSDT Launch Time  2025-02-06 15:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset Berachain (BERA) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the BERAUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2025-02-06 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-02-06 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-02-07 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-02-07 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the BERAUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the BERAUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the BERAUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The BERAUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Binance Team 2025-02-06 Note: This announcement was amended on 2025-02-06 to clarify that the ticksize for BERAUSDT is 0.001.
